$comment: What the coder role (epoch 3 E2 s3) answers at the end of its turn: ONE JSON object, the REPORT. The coder changes files in its own worktree and nothing else: coai (not the coder) formats, commits, builds and tests, and takes the list of changed files from git, so this report names no file and no commit. Arm `ok` carries one entry for EVERY dod id of the task (an id the task does not have, a missing id and a repeated id are errors) and optional notes; `met` is the coder's own claim and never makes a job green by itself. Arm `refused` carries a reason. The dod id pattern is the one of shared/work-plan.schema.json, verbatim - the tests of ACoderContractTests hold the two equal; neither half has a JSON Schema engine, so coai-mcp reads this shape with its own strict reader (core/Coder/CoderReport.cs) and that test is the guard against drift. An unknown key is an error, in either arm: a `evidnce` typo must not pass. Which dod ids the task has is NOT in this file: the reader is told.
title: coai coder report
